elements.requirement: The Welsh Ministers award compensation by giving a compensation notice to the registered social landlord and to the person to be compensated.
elements.quote: Compensation is awarded by the Welsh Ministers giving notice (a “compensation notice”) to— (a) the registered social landlord, and (b) the person to be compensated.

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must specify the grounds on which the compensation is awarded.
elements.quote: The notice must specify— (a) the grounds on which the compensation is awarded

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must specify the amount of the compensation.
elements.quote: The notice must specify— (a) the grounds on which the compensation is awarded, (b) the amount of the compensation

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must specify the person who is to be compensated.
elements.quote: The notice must specify— (a) the grounds on which the compensation is awarded, (b) the amount of the compensation, (c) the person to be compensated

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must specify a period within which the compensation must be paid.
elements.quote: The notice must specify— (a) the grounds on which the compensation is awarded, (b) the amount of the compensation, (c) the person to be compensated, (d) a period within which it must be paid

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must specify any interest or additional compensation payable under section 50U(2) if payment is made late.
elements.quote: any interest or additional compensation which, by virtue of section 50U(2), is payable in the event of late payment.

elements.requirement: A compensation notice may require the registered social landlord to publish information concerning the compensation award in a specified manner.
elements.quote: The notice may require the registered social landlord to publish information about the compensation award in a specified manner.

elements.requirement: A compensation notice must explain the statutory effect of sections 50U(1), 50U(3), and 50V.
elements.quote: The notice must explain the effect of sections 50U(1) and (3) and 50V.
